url.description: The full base URL of your Nextcloud server (e.g., https://cloud.example.com)

username.description: Username to pre-fill in login dialog (optional). Leave blank to prompt user.

app_password.description: App password or OAuth client secret for non-interactive login (optional). If omitted, user must enter credentials.

webdav_contacts.description: Enable synchronization of contacts via WebDAV

webdav_calendars.description: Enable synchronization of calendars via WebDAV

webdav_files.description: Enable synchronization of files via WebDAV (Nextcloud Files app)

webdav_paths.description: Custom WebDAV paths (e.g., remote.php/dav/files/username/MyFolder). One per line. Useful for non-standard setups. This is a list of strings, not a single string.
